ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels, with approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area falling into the low-to-mid intensity range (dark grey/black) and 10-15% in the high-intensity range (white/light grey marbling and scarring).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity base across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity vertical stripe at the peduncle base. Diffuse grey-to-white mottling concentrated in the upper-mid regions of both lobes, appearing as non-contiguous geometric streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; the notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and variable-amplitude serration map. Visible peaks are more pronounced on the outer lateral thirds of both lobes, with a significant jagged irregular notch on the inner-right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-curved sigmoid trajectory; concave curvature near the median notch transitioning to convex curvature as it approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single high-contrast white circular cluster on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe and two small white circular clusters on the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel diagonal linear disruptions of lighter grey pixels located on the mid-left lobe; one single diagonal linear disruption on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical high-intensity white streak at the fluke base junction; irregular pixel-depth voids along the trailing edge boundary consistent with physical tissue removal.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white vertical band at the center base of the fluke provides a high-contrast structural marker against the dark water surface.
